desc:
WELCOME TO +1 HOME RUN FORGE!

Train your swings, forge powerful bats, and smash through every stage!

Think you can become the strongest batter? It's time to find out!

🔥 **WHAT YOU CAN DO:**
⚾ Train your swings using pitching machines to gain strength!
💥 Break through stages and discover new loot!
⛏️ Collect loot and bring it to the forge!
🔨 Forge random bats using the loot you collect!
🏏 Unlock stronger and rarer bats as you progress!
💎 Collect tons of unique bat skins!
📈 Upgrade your strength and become more powerful!
🏆 Keep grinding to reach the endgame!

💪 **BETTER LOOT = BETTER BATS!**

The stronger you become, the farther you can go. Keep training, keep forging, and see how powerful your bats can get.

👍 Like the game and join the adventure!
